dedupe_keys.name: a unified framework for active power reactive power and voltage pseudomeasurement generation in pv only mv feeders

description: The model uses one year of 15-minute SCADA measurements to generate active-power, reactive-power and voltage pseudomeasurements for PV-only medium-voltage feeders. The source describes a linear active-power method and clustered XGBoost reactive-power/voltage estimation without weather or topology inputs. The companion workbook explicitly documents analytical verification of this method. It is retained as a supporting component, without assuming that its worksheets release original SCADA measurements. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: A Unified Framework for Active Power, Reactive Power, and Voltage Pseudomeasurement Generation in PV-only MV Feeders
